exportBody: Pick recipes to save as a file. Rewards, web requests and named viewers stay out of the file, so whoever imports it sets those up on their own channel.
exportMissing: {n} could not be found on this channel.
exportFailed: Left out because they no longer validate: {names}
exportScrubbed: Something that looked like a key or password was taken out of these. Check them before you share the file:
exportError: Could not export those recipes. Try again in a moment.
importBody: Imported recipes arrive turned off, and nothing you already have is overwritten. Only import files from people you trust.
importDrop: Click to choose a recipe file, or drop it here
importSlots: This channel has room for {n} more.
importError: Could not reach the importer. Try again in a moment.

setup.reward_trigger: Pick the channel point reward that starts this.
setup.event_filter: An event filter named someone else's viewer or reward. Set it again.
setup.users_list: A list of allowed or blocked viewers was cleared. Set it again.
setup.login_target: A step aimed at a specific viewer was turned off. Pick who it targets.
setup.http_target: A web request was turned off and its address removed. Add your own.
setup.reward_target: A reward change was turned off and its reward removed. Pick your own.
setup.lights_target: A lights step was turned off and its device removed. Pick your own light.
setup.slash_command: A step that ran a chat command was turned off and blanked. Rewrite it if you want it.
setup.secret_removed: A step held something that should not be shared, so it was turned off and blanked. Rewrite it if you want it.
setup.run_removed: A step that ran another recipe not in this import was removed.
setup.run_target_simple: A step that ran another recipe was removed, because that recipe is saved as a command or alert and cannot be run.
setup.link_failed: Could not link a step that runs another recipe. Add it again.

review.command_in_use: !{detail} is already a command here, so this may not answer.

issue.file_too_large: This file is over the size limit.
issue.invalid_json: This is not a valid recipe file.
issue.invalid_format: This is not a valid recipe file.
issue.unknown_format: This file is not a recipe file.
issue.unsupported_version: This file comes from a newer version. It cannot be read here yet.
issue.unknown_field: This file has fields that are not allowed.
issue.too_many: This file has too many recipes.
issue.uses_token: Uses {count} or {uses}, which only work in plain commands.
issue.command_exists: This command name is already in use here. Nothing was changed.
issue.alert_exists: You already have this alert set up, and importing would replace it. Nothing was changed.
issue.generic: Something in this recipe is not valid ({code}).
